sentences.text: Mr.Ashish Gehlot for Mr.T.C.Sharma.

Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Kuldeep Mathur
 Order

This application for bail under Section 439 Cr.P.C. has been filed by the petitioner who has been arrested in connection with FIR No.16/2023 registered at Police Station Rawla, District Sriganganagar, for offences under Sections 363 IPC, 5(L)/6 of POCSO Act in alternate 376(2)(N)
IPC.
Learned counsel for the petitioner submitted that the petitioner has been falsely implicated in the present case.
Learned counsel submitted that the petitioner who is aged about 18 years and the prosecutrix who is aged about 16 years were in a platonic love affair.

Drawing attention of the Court towards charge sheet and various documents annexed to the charge sheet by the Investigating Agency, learned counsel for the petitioner submitted (2 of 3) [CRLMB-8868/2023] that the prosecutrix voluntarily developed sexual relationship with the present petitioner.
However, when she was caught with the present petitioner on a motorbike, the prosecutrix under the pressure of her family members has roped petitioner in a false criminal case.

Learned counsel submitted that the petitioner is in judicial custody, challan has been filed and the trial of the case will take sufficiently long time to be concluded, therefore, no fruitful purpose would be served by keeping the petitioner who is aged about 18 years behind the bars for an indefinite period.

sentences.text: On the strength of aforesaid arguments, learned counsel prayed that the petitioner deserves to be enlarged on bail.
Per contra, learned Public Prosecutor and learned counsel for the complainant have opposed the bail application.
Heard learned counsel for the parties.
Perused the material available on record.
Having considered the rival submissions, facts and circumstances of the case, without expressing any opinion on merits/demerits of the case, this Court is inclined to enlarge the petitioner on bail.

Accordingly, the bail application under Section 439 Cr.P.C. is allowed and it is ordered that the accused-petitioner- Rakesh Kumar S/o Prem Kumar shall be enlarged on bail in connection with FIR No.16/2023 registered at Police Station Rawla, District Sriganganagar, provided he furnishes a personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- with two sureties of Rs.25,000/- each to the satisfaction of the learned trial Judge for his appearance before (3 of 3) [CRLMB-8868/2023] the court concerned on all the dates of hearing as and when called upon to so.
It is however, made clear that findings recorded/observations made above are for limited purposes of adjudication of bail application.
The trial court shall not get prejudiced by the same.
(KULDEEP MATHUR),J Prashant Sr.No.226 Powered by TCPDF (www.tcpdf.org)
